section_1.behavior: Reveal infographic beats sequentially; no sound required; replay optional.

section_2.behavior: Orbit settles into view; click event nodes; hover highlight; detail card; Escape/outside click closes.

section_3.behavior: Slab rises into view; cards lift on hover; connector brightens; click opens panel; selected card remains highlighted.
section_3.mobile: Flatten into accessible stacked cards while retaining section order.

section_4.behavior: Pin section; map scroll progress 0–100% to horizontal journey; nodes progress hollow→active→filled; connectors fill.

accessibility.keyboard: All interactive elements are buttons and keyboard reachable.
